messages:
ana: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need to finalize customer comms and action owners for remediation. Items: status page sentence, 72h customer summary, and RCA-sharing policy.

 tom: I'll draft the statuspage blurb: "Elevated latency on Text Generation API from 02:05-02:48 UTC due to cache eviction during a model rollout. Rollback applied; mitigation in progress. No customer data exposed."

 legal: Legal prefers a redacted public summary. Full RCA can be shared with affected enterprise customers under NDA/DPA. Post a redaction checklist here and we'll review.

 sec-bot: Security scan complete  no exfiltration detected. Signed off on the "No customer data exposed" line.

 ops: Once the final copy is posted to #statuspage-drafts, ProdOps can push.

 eng-runtime: We'll create a guardrail ticket to prevent mass KV eviction during rollouts (RUNTIME-999).

 ana: Action list: Tom finalize statuspage and post (due 2398765450); Ana draft 72h customer summary with TL;DR, timeline, and FAQ (due 2398765470); Legal publish redaction checklist here (due 2398765460); Eng-runtime to open guardrail ticket and assign (due 2398765480). Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done and add blockers in-thread.
